statement: A counterexample to Kaplansky’s zero-divisor conjecture. Constructs a finitely presented torsion-free group G whose group algebra $`\mathbb F_2[G]`$ has nonzero zero divisors, disproving Kaplansky's zero-divisor conjecture. The group has a finite two-dimensional classifying space.
